prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a production 2x2 story illustration atlas for the Klaryus tutoring landing page, landscape 3:2 overall, four equally sized 3:2 landscape panels, exactly aligned to half width and half height, no gutters, no borders. Each quadrant is one complete coherent illustrated scene, not isolated floating objects. Four panels in reading order (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right) tell a small story about a panda tutor teaching baby pandas at a bamboo school.
Character continuity: SAME friendly adult panda teacher in all panels, round delicate navy glasses, a small coral scarf, soft black-white fur, cream belly, navy/coral satchel, fully dimensional organic body and clearly visible natural paws/feet, no stick/supports. Very readable face and emotional eyes, teacher fairly large in each composition (around one third scene height). SAME three small panda pupils with blue, coral and sage schoolbags. 
Panel 1 top left MORNING: smiling bright-eyed panda tutor walks along a DRY warm ivory stone path towards a beautiful small bamboo school with blue/coral details, two baby pandas nearby with books, bamboo forest around. A grounded, welcoming story setting. Feet contact path with natural small shadows.
Panel 2 top right AFTER CLASS PREPARATION: inside same bamboo school, teacher seated at wooden desk looking unmistakably overwhelmed/tired with raised worried eyebrows and downturned mouth, hands supporting head, moderate scattered notebooks and task sheets on desk, warm WOODEN floor visible, a little panda pupil waiting with notebook. All objects resting physically on desk, shelf or floor. No illegible text.
Panel 3 bottom left ORGANIZED LESSON: inside same bamboo classroom, smiling confident teacher at neatly arranged wooden table, simple navy-blue laptop and blue task book, three engaged little panda pupils around table working on open books, teacher gently pointing/explaining a task. Warm wooden floor visible. Facial expression clearly happy and engaged, room calm and inviting.
Panel 4 bottom right EVENING FREE: same teacher relaxed and joyous walking HOME down a dry stone path from bamboo school, satchel packed and notebook closed, two baby pandas wave goodbye near school, gentle peach-coral evening sun in soft blue sky, bamboo leaves. Clear ground contact, peaceful open air and warm emotion.
Style: premium modern illustrated animated-film storybook art, painterly gouache mixed with soft sculptural clay volume, finely designed bamboo architecture, lush but restrained organic details, lively and inviting, grown-up aesthetic suitable for tutor website, beautiful coherent lighting, no primitive geometric placeholder look, no cut-out cardboard figures. Color palette brand deep blue #00629d, coral #f34e52, warm cream #faf8f6, pale sky blue, subtle sage bamboo; avoid pink, mustard/yellow dominant blocks, swampy dark teal ground. Full scene backgrounds, no typography/text/numbers/labels/logos/watermarks. Important: each of the four scene illustrations independently fits exactly one equal quadrant; all characters and important props stay well inside panel edges; no scene crosses the central x/y boundaries. All panels have same visual scale/style and character design.
